response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, open-source contributions, and exposure to agentic workflows and event-driven systems, but lacks clear evidence of leading multi-agent AI systems at scale in regulated fintech environments, managing teams beyond 10 people, or designing financial risk/credit systems — key requirements for this CTO role.
strengths: Hands-on experience with agentic workflows and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Proven track record in event-driven, distributed systems (GISCollective, Dunnhumby)
Strong engineering culture advocacy via testing, CI/CD, and knowledge sharing
concerns: No demonstrated experience in fintech infrastructure or regulated AI systems
Lacks evidence of scaling engineering teams to 30+ or developing senior technical leadership layers
No visible involvement in real-time credit risk, working capital, or compliance infrastructure
